description.value: Climb On Equipment is a specialty outdoor and technical climbing gear retailer in Vancouver, stocking a broad range of products for rock climbing, alpine climbing, ice climbing, work and rescue applications, and backcountry camping. The store carries harnesses, ropes, protection hardware, helmets, footwear, tents, sleep systems, and technical apparel from leading brands. Cycle tourists may find it useful for camping supplies and outdoor apparel, but it is not a bike shop.
